item.title: PHOTOS: London's Mother Teresa wins OFSAA AAA boys basketball gold
item.description: London’s Mother Teresa Spartans beat Toronto AY Jackson 59-51 at Fanshawe College on Wednesday night to win the Ontario Federation of School Athletic Associations (OFSAA) AAA boys basketball gold. They’re the first London team to do so since the 1950s. Photos by LFP’s Mike Hensen mhensen@postmedia.com

item.title: Window and door firm sues ex-accountant, alleging he gambled away $700K
item.description: A Southwestern Ontario window and door company is suing its former accountant for allegedly misappropriating nearly $700,000 to gamble. Brookstone Windows and Doors, a Windsor-based company with a dozen locations across southern Ontario, filed a $1-million lawsuit against London resident Eric Richardson alleging breach of fiduciary duty, breach of contract, theft and other damages.
